about.text: Skim milk powder heated only lightly before drying, so most of its whey protein stays undenatured (WPNI above 6.0 mg/g). It is the grade for milk fortification, cottage cheese, cultured skim milk and chocolate milk drinks.

links.name: US Dairy Export Council: Non-fat dry milk and skim milk powder

facts.v: The 1971 ADM Institute classes, as summarised in a Technews review, give other heat figures: low 75 °C for 20 s, medium 85-105 °C for 1-2 min, high 120-135 °C for 2-3 min
